note: The parser configuration supplies the Regex property bytes, including an unterminated UTF-8 leading byte at the end of the pattern.
The input-controlled Regex value is passed to the regular expression compiler.
The regex compiler is invoked with the end pointer immediately after the candidate pattern bytes.
For an incomplete multibyte character, enclen can advance the scanner past end; the safety condition p <= end should still hold before later copying.
The token range derived from the advanced source pointer is appended to the existing string node.
The copy reads bytes from s up to an end pointer that is beyond the allocated regex pattern buffer, causing an out-of-bounds read.
